mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above the prior 12-month average precedes a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to expectations of tighter policy and reduced risk appetite.
failure_condition: Over 12 consecutive FEDFUNDS hikes, 20-day forward returns remain non-negative or the policy shift is not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (employment) coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as stronger labor market strength supports corporate optimism and higher earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Over a 12-month period with rising PAYEMS, 60-day forward returns show no statistically significant outperformance versus a baseline of flat labor growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in GDPC1 (goods orders) followed by a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return reflects anticipatory corporate investment and higher future earnings from increased demand.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth is not statistically predictive of SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.05) across multiple demand cycles in tight supply environments.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO (industrial production) triggers a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as weak manufacturing signals reduced economic momentum and investor caution.
failure_condition: INDPRO recovers without a corresponding SPX rebound within 60 days, or the effect is not significant in non-recessionary regimes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly increases in FEDFUNDS exceeding 0.25 percentage points for two months produce a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as markets price in a prolonged tightening cycle.
failure_condition: No significant positive return in 20 out of 30 such FEDFUNDS tightening episodes (binomial test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE (unemployment) below 4.5% triggers a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return as lower labor market friction increases inflationary expectations and market volatility.
failure_condition: Over 10 such UNRATE declines, the 20-day forward returns remain non-negative or the effect is not statistically significant (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in both GDPC1 and HOUST (retail sales) produce a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return via synergistic demand expansion and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: In 20% of such interaction events, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in RSAFS (inventory) coincides with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as reduced inventories signal improved absorption and corporate optimism.
failure_condition: Over 10 such RSAFS declines, 20-day forward returns are not statistically superior to a baseline of stable inventories (t-test p > 0.05).
